source_caption_text:
2010 was really a different time 

“Right Above It” by Lil Wayne featuring Drake is one of the defining hip-hop collaborations of 2010. Released as the lead single from Wayne’s I Am Not a Human Being, the track is powered by Kane Beatz’s triumphant production and captures the larger-than-life energy of the Young Money era.

The song became an instant anthem, with Drake delivering the confident hook before Lil Wayne takes over with his signature punchlines and unmistakable delivery. The chemistry between the two helped make the record one of the most memorable collaborations of that period.

For many fans, “Right Above It” is more than just a hit from 2010. Hearing those opening horns can instantly bring back memories of wired headphones, school hallways, iPods, and the feeling of starting the day with Lil Wayne and Drake playing in your ears.
